nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: Emberguard patrol. Halt.
This sector is under watch. State allegiance.
"Ashen Veil infiltrators. Three confirmed inside the city walls. We haven't found them yet."

nodes.speaker: ash_prophet_npc
lines: Quiet camp. No fire. No colors.
Three cult members eating in silence. They look up without surprise.

choices.text: [Deception - INT] Pose as a new recruit.

lines: They accept you without fanfare. "The Sovereign's work doesn't wait for introductions." Someone passes you a cup of something bitter.
"The third gate. Two nights from now. The Sovereign wants the shrine active by dawn."

nodes.speaker: faction_envoy_thornpact
lines: The envoy slides her hand out of her leaf-cloak pocket.
"You're not Iron Covenant. And you're not Veil." A beat. "Interesting."
"Thornpact intelligence reports. 30 gold each. Or we can trade information — but I'd need something worth trading for."

choices.text: Offer what you know about the Veil cell.

lines: "Vague. I respect that." She slides something across — a sealed packet. "For when you decide to stop being vague."
"I've met a hundred people who were bad at secrets. You're average." She walks away.

nodes.speaker: ancient_guardian_npc
lines: The emissary is old enough that the bark of the trees seems to have grown around her memory.
"The Pact sent me to find who still holds their end of it."

choices.text: Claim to hold the old covenant.

lines: "Protect the sacred sites. Do not burn the old groves. Stand against those who would remake the land."
"The Ashen Veil stands against all three. Do you?"

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: Iron Covenant checkpoint. Transit tax — three gold per party member.
Pay, or take the long road. Those are the only options.

choices.text: Pay. (12 gold for party of four)
[Diplomacy - INT] Challenge the legal basis of the tax.

lines: He finds the loophole before you finish explaining it. "...Exempt. Travel on. Don't make a habit of it."
"Wrong answer. Six gold now, and you pay before asking."

nodes.speaker: merchant_unusual
lines: Plague Harvester recruiter. Coin upfront, percentage of collection on the back end.
They don't ask what you're collecting it for.

choices.text: [Requires emberguard_allied] Memorize the recruiter's face for the Emberguard.

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: Guild charter post. You can register as members — or rivals.
Members get road intel. Rivals get watched.

nodes.speaker: marek_greel_story
lines: Thornwhisper Circle scholar. She's copying surviving texts by hand.
"Knowledge preservation. Before the Veil gets the rest of it."

choices.text: [Arcana - INT] Help transcribe for a few hours.
Offer to share any lore you've collected.

lines: She looks at your copy. "...Accurate, but I cannot read this. Thank you for the effort."

choices.text: Leave her to the real work.

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: Captain Maer. She's heard about you from the gate.
"Word travels. You've made an impression — which is either a good thing or a very bad one."

choices.text: Report what you know about the cult cells.

lines: "That's three cells we didn't know about." She nods slowly. "You've earned this." She hands over a sealed credential.
"There's a bounty on the cult captain — calls himself the Herald. Fifty gold and Emberguard recognition for proof of death."

nodes.speaker: veil_convert
lines: She was Veil. Past tense.
"I need to get the brand off my wrist before the Harvesters find me. Or before the Veil finds me for leaving."

choices.text: Help her. Lead her to safety.
[Diplomacy - INT] Interrogate her about the Veil first.

lines: She talks fast — the Veil cell locations, the Herald's next move. Then: "Now please. Help me."
She bolts. Can't blame her.

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: The Oathless camp here — former Emberguard who broke covenant.
They fight for gold now. No flags, no causes, no exceptions.

choices.text: Hire them for the next combat. (50 gold)
Ask why they left the Emberguard.

lines: "The Captain ordered us to burn a village. 'Cult sympathizers.' Most of them weren't."
"We refused the order. She gave it to someone else. So here we are."

nodes.speaker: brightfall_innkeeper
lines: Brightfall Council envoy. She's looking for independent contractors.
"The Council can't be seen to move against the Veil directly. Politics. You understand."

choices.text: Decline. You don't work for politics.

lines: "...Fine. Double the fee and Council protection from the Iron Covenant's tax collectors."

nodes.speaker: ancient_guardian_npc
lines: The final renewal of the Ancient Pact.
"Every generation that honored it is here. In the stone. Watching."

nodes.speaker: ashen_veil_herald
lines: The veilspawn herald speaks in almost-words.
Something reaches through the sound and you understand: it is offering passage.

choices.text: [Occult - INT] Accept parley through the Veil language.

lines: Passage through the gate in exchange for not destroying the core shrine. The veilspawn are not interested in dying — only in the rift staying open.

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: The Emberguard is stretched thin. We can’t afford another breach.
What brings you to our territory?

nodes.speaker: brightfall_innkeeper
lines: Tensions rise in Brightfall. People are nervous.
What news do you carry?

choices.text: Share news of the Ashen Veil.

nodes.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines: The cult moves through the shadows.
Knowledge can turn the tide.

choices.text: Share what you know about their movements.
Ask her about the cult's plans.

nodes.speaker: ash_prophet_npc
lines: The Sovereign speaks through us.
You grasp at shadows in a world of light.

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: The gate's power is shifting. We need to decide quickly.
Staying here means risking everything. But leaving might mean losing control.

choices.text: Advise to stay and observe the gate.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The Veil's whispers grow louder at the gate.
We can't just walk away. This is our chance for insight.

choices.text: Propose to investigate the whispers further.
Counsel to ignore the whispers and back away.

lines: You take a moment to focus. The whispers start forming images in your mind.
It's a glimpse of something lost, yet tantalizingly close.

choices.text: Follow the images deeper into the Veil.

nodes.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines: I fought for the Emberguard once, but now...
This feels like the end of everything we fought to protect.

choices.text: Encourage renewing the fight for the Emberguard.
Advise to abandon the Emberguard for a new path.

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: Brightfall needs unity. The Emberguard stands as a bulwark now.
Will you lend your strength to our cause?

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The Ashen Veil claims to seek truth, yet they spread lies.
Will you help us gather evidence against them?

nodes.speaker: ash_prophet_npc
lines: The air here feels heavy with secrets. A gathered crowd watches silently.
They've chosen this spot for a reason. Hope mingles with fear.

choices.text: Question the prophet about their plans.

lines: "Our time is now. The Sovereign's return is imminent." They glance at you, waiting for a reaction.

choices.text: Inquire about the Sovereign's true nature.

nodes.speaker: elderwood_hermit
lines: The heartstone is failing. The land bleeds from its wounds.
We must decide whether to mend or let it die.

choices.text: Allow the heartstone to fade away.

nodes.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines: We can't ignore the consequences of our choices today.
If the heartstone falls, the Pact weakens further.

choices.text: [Diplomacy - CHA] Persuade Yasha to support restoration.
Remain neutral and silent about the heartstone.

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: The Emberguard maintains order here. What do you seek?
State your purpose clearly, or face scrutiny.

choices.text: Declare your allegiance to the Emberguard.
Ask about the Emberguard's recent challenges.

lines: "The Ashen Veil's influence grows. We've lost patrols in the Gloomridge."
"Political pressure from the Council hampers our efficacy."

nodes.speaker: brightfall_innkeeper
lines: Rumors swirl in the air, but few dare speak their names here.
The inn is a refuge. What brings you to this corner of Emberwood?

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: The road is treacherous. What do you intend to do about it?
Patrols are scarce. Choose your allies wisely.
"We've seen strange symbols carved near the old shrine."
"Two townsfolk went missing last week, likely culprits are nearby."

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The Veil's whispers reach all corners. What do you seek?
Knowledge comes at a price, traveler.

choices.text: Attempt to negotiate for a better deal.

lines: "A fair trade is worth more than gold. What can you provide?"
"Information is a currency in these woods."

choices.text: Share what you know about the Emberguard.

nodes.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines: The balance is shifting. What role will you play?
Alliances are crucial; choose wisely.

choices.text: Offer support to the Ancient Pact.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The shrine stands in disrepair, as do the promises of the Council.
A few followers gather, whispering about the Veil's truth. They notice you.

nodes.speaker: ash_prophet_npc
lines: They call this a sanctuary. I call it a prison of lies.
The air thickens with lost hopes, but some still listen.

choices.text: Offer your support to their cause.
Deny any affiliation with the cult.

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: The Guard is stretched thin. We've lost ground in the Veilscar.
Trust no one here. Not even your own reflections.

choices.text: Assure the Captain of your loyalty.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The air thickens with dread. You stand at the edge of the known.
"The Sovereign's whispers grow louder. Are you prepared for the truth?"

choices.text: Demand to know the truth without pretense.
Avoid the question. Pretend you seek guidance.

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: State your purpose. The Guard has its eyes open here.
Your intentions can change the course of the day. Choose wisely.

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: The Emberguard is stretched thin. We could use allies in these woods.
What brings you to our jurisdiction?

choices.text: Offer your support to the Emberguard.
Ask about the situation with the Ashen Veil.

lines: "We suspect infiltration. Cultists have been spotted near the mill."
"Stay vigilant. The Veil's influence is insidious."

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: Patrol here is a matter of duty.
State your alignment for our records.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The shrine's heartstone flickers weakly.
It remembers what it was. Now it fears what it could become.

choices.text: [Mechanisms - INT] Try to stabilize the heartstone.
Ask about its history and current state.

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: The Emberguard once protected this place.
Now we stand outside, unsure of how to proceed.

choices.text: Reaffirm your support for the Emberguard.

nodes.speaker: elderwood_hermit
lines: The Pact's roots here are thin.
What happens next may decide the land's fate.

choices.text: Ask for wisdom on the next steps.
Remain neutral in the face of conflict.

nodes.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines: We tread carefully. The Sovereign's influence is heavy.
What will you choose when the ground falls away?

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: The Emberguard oversees these woods.
Your purpose must align with our interests. State it clearly.

choices.text: Offer your support to the Emberguard.
Declare your neutrality in the matter.

nodes.speaker: ash_prophet_npc
lines: The Veil's whispers grow louder tonight.
What do you seek among our shadows?

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The Riftgate hums with tension. A choice lies ahead.
The Keeper's eyes search yours, weighing your resolve.

choices.text: Voice support for the Ashen Veil.

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: The Gate's heartbeat quickens. Something's coming.
I won't lead my men into madness.
"We follow orders from the Council. Their will guides us." Maer hesitates.

choices.text: Express trust in the Guard's intentions.

nodes.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines: The Veil's whispers grow louder. Can you hear them?
Choices weigh heavy here; each path is fraught.

nodes.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines: The ground rumbles underfoot. Tread carefully.
There's power here that corrupts. Will you harness it?

choices.text: Attempt to harness the power of the Riftgate.
Reject the power and its temptations.

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: The Emberguard's needs are simple. Safety for the Emberwood.
Align with us, and your path is clear.

nodes.speaker: brightfall_innkeeper
lines: The Brightfall Council listens to whispers in the dark.
Tell me, what side are you on?

choices.text: Claim allegiance to the Brightfall Council.

nodes.speaker: ash_prophet_npc
lines: The air hums with tension. Even the shadows seem to watch us closely.
The Ashen Veil remains committed to our purpose. You'd do well to consider your own.

choices.text: Offer allegiance to the Ashen Veil.
Inquire about the Veil's true purpose.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The shrine's energy pulses weakly. It craves something essential.
We are losing ground, and the Sovereign's influence spreads.

choices.text: Offer to help restore the shrine.
Walk away from the shrine's plight.

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: You stand at the boundary. The Emberguard's reach is limited here.
State your purpose. The Council is watching.

choices.text: Declare your reason for coming here.
Ask about the Council's interests here.

lines: "The Gloomridge has become a focal point for unrest. We're here to contain it."

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: This path is less traveled. Rumors swirl. Choose your company wisely.
Everyone's on edge. The Veil whispers.

nodes.speaker: ash_prophet_npc
lines: This land wears a shroud. The Veil's hand moves unseen.
You tread where many have fallen. What do you seek here?

nodes.speaker: bone_reader
lines: The past whispers through the bones.
I see paths entwined with ash and shadow.
"The Sovereign is not the only puppet here. The strings run deep."

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: You do not belong here. This shrine is sacred.
What would you disrupt for profit or glory?

choices.text: Offer something sacred to prove your intent.

nodes.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines: We guard the remnants of what was.
What has the Ashen Veil promised you?

choices.text: [Deception - INT] Spin a tale of alliance.

nodes.speaker: faction_envoy_thornpact
lines: We are here to observe. To learn from the Veil.
What brings you to this haunted ground?

nodes.speaker: brightfall_innkeeper
lines: You look like you've seen the other side.
Some say the Rift should never be touched again.

choices.text: Ask for their thoughts on the Rift.

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: You stand near a crossroads. The Guard's presence is a reminder.
Are you here to offer assistance or inquiry?
"The trail's been harried by cultists. Caution is advised."
He gestures at the trees, their shadows hiding more than just foliage.

nodes.speaker: brightfall_innkeeper
lines: A busy inn, filled with whispers of the Guard.
"You looking to trade information or just shelter?"

choices.text: Trade information about local cult activity.
